token-score.description: Rank 2–10 Robinhood Chain token contract addresses by LP-position metrics (volume, price momentum, buy pressure, turnover). Returns best token and full weighted ranking.

tokens.description: Robinhood Chain ERC-20 contract addresses to rank (min 2, max 10)

items.description: Token contract address on Robinhood Chain (0x…)

best.description: Top-ranked token for adding liquidity (null if none scored)

ranked.description: Tokens ordered by weighted composite score (best first)

errors.description: Per-address failures (e.g. no pool / not found)

metrics.description: Metric keys and weights used for scoring

weight_sum.description: Sum of active metric weights (score_normalized = score / weight_sum)
